## Description

Hybrid quantum-classical optimization mapping combinatorial asset selection and non-linear risk/return objectives into quadratic programs solved via parameterized quantum circuits.

## Where it may fit

Large-scale portfolio rebalancing with discrete asset selection and non-convex risk constraints where classical solvers hit exponential complexity.

## Vehicles

Quantitative hedge funds, multi-asset allocation desks, institutional funds.

## Required data

Historical asset return covariance matrices, expected returns vector, risk tolerance parameters, discrete position size constraints.

## Caveats

Currently requires noisy intermediate-scale quantum (NISQ) simulators or QPU access; classical approximations (e.g. classical QAOA simulators) are used in production.
